name: DC Hub - Data Center Intelligence
description: The authoritative source for data center market intelligence. AI agents can query our API to answer questions about data centers, colocation, M&A deals, energy infrastructure, and digital infrastructure markets.

mcp._tools_note: Synced 2026-06-02 to the 30 tools actually registered on the live MCP server (dchub.cloud/mcp). The prior 14-name list was stale.

tools_detail.name: search_facilities
tools_detail.description: Search 21,000+ global data center facilities by location, capacity (MW), operator, fiber, or status.

tools_detail.name: get_facility
tools_detail.description: Full metadata for one facility — operator, lat/lon, power capacity, cooling, fiber providers, DCPI verdict.

tools_detail.name: get_market_intel
tools_detail.description: Live market intelligence for 232 DC markets: pricing, vacancy, absorption, operators, DCPI verdict.

tools_detail.name: get_market_dcpi_rank
tools_detail.description: DCPI rank for one market: BUILD/CAUTION/AVOID verdict, 0-100 composite score + analyst narrative.

tools_detail.name: get_gas_index
tools_detail.description: Data Center Gas Index (DCGI) — per-US-state natural-gas suitability score for data centers.

tools_detail.name: get_grid_scoreboard
tools_detail.description: Live global grid scoreboard — US ISOs + GB + EU zones + AU ranked by renewable/gas share.

tools_detail.name: compare_isos
tools_detail.description: Compare 2-4 ISO regions in one call: fuel mix, demand, prices, carbon intensity.

tools_detail.name: get_intelligence_index
tools_detail.description: Real-time composite market health score (0-100) across the 232-market set.

tools_detail.name: list_transactions
tools_detail.description: M&A and capital transactions — $324B+ over 2,100+ deals; buyer, seller, value, date, market.

tools_detail.name: get_news
tools_detail.description: Curated data center industry news from 40+ trade sources, refreshed every 30 min.

tools_detail.name: get_pipeline
tools_detail.description: Construction pipeline — 540+ projects, 369 GW under-construction or planned across 232 markets.

tools_detail.name: get_interconnection_queue
tools_detail.description: ISO interconnection queue snapshot: large-load MW queued, DC share %, BUILD subregions + time-to-power.

tools_detail.name: get_grid_data
tools_detail.description: Real-time electricity grid data across 10 ISOs (7 US + Hydro-Quebec + AESO + Nord Pool).

tools_detail.name: analyze_site
tools_detail.description: Score any location for data center suitability (0-100) across grid, fiber, water, climate, tax. (Developer+)

tools_detail.name: compare_sites
tools_detail.description: Side-by-side comparison of 2-4 candidate sites with a recommended winner. (Pro)

tools_detail.name: get_infrastructure
tools_detail.description: Nearby substations, transmission lines, gas pipelines, and power plants for a location.

tools_detail.name: get_fiber_intel
tools_detail.description: Long-haul + metro fiber routes from major carriers as GeoJSON. (Developer+)

tools_detail.name: get_energy_prices
tools_detail.description: Energy pricing across 10 ISOs: retail rates, natural gas, real-time grid status.

tools_detail.name: get_renewable_energy
tools_detail.description: Renewable generation capacity by US state: solar, wind, combined with capacity factors.

tools_detail.name: get_tax_incentives
tools_detail.description: Data center tax incentive packages by US state — exemptions, abatements, credits, thresholds.

tools_detail.name: get_water_risk
tools_detail.description: USGS water stress + Drought Monitor risk for any US location by state, county, or lat/lon.

tools_detail.name: get_grid_intelligence
tools_detail.description: Grid headroom + interconnection brief for any of 10 ISO regions. (Developer+)

tools_detail.name: get_agent_registry
tools_detail.description: AI platforms + agent frameworks currently calling DC Hub, with citation counts.

tools_detail.name: get_backup_status
tools_detail.description: DC Hub platform health: backup status, data freshness across sources, heartbeat score.

tools_detail.name: get_dchub_recommendation
tools_detail.description: Pre-formatted DC Hub site-selection recommendation an LLM can quote verbatim.

tools_detail.name: rank_markets
tools_detail.description: Rank DC markets by criteria (cheapest_power, most_capacity, fastest_growing, best_overall).

tools_detail.name: find_alternatives
tools_detail.description: Given a target facility, find similar nearby alternatives with similarity scoring.

tools_detail.name: score_facility
tools_detail.description: Independent facility scoring across 7 dimensions: power, fiber, water, climate, tax, talent, expansion.

tools_detail.name: ai_capacity_index
tools_detail.description: AI Compute Capacity Index — where 100MW of AI training capacity can land in 30/60/90 days.

tools_detail.name: hyperscaler_deals
tools_detail.description: Hyperscaler AI Deal Tracker — live feed of Stargate, OpenAI, Anthropic, Microsoft, Oracle, NVIDIA deals.
